intro: A Plainstrider Talon is a sharp claw harvested from the large, flightless plainstriders native to Mulgore. Tauren shamans use these talons alongside other natural reagents to craft sacred cleansing totems when the land's water sources are corrupted.

p: The large, flightless plainstriders roam the open grasses of Mulgore, relying on powerful legs and sharp claws to defend against predators and forage through the tough prairie earth. To the tauren of Bloodhoof Village, every part of a hunted beast carries spiritual resonance. When goblin ventures tainted sacred sources like the Winterhoof Water Well, shaman Mull Thunderhorn sought plainstrider talons alongside prairie wolf paws. In tauren ritual crafting, gathering reagents from native predators and foragers allows the spiritual essence of the land to be channeled into totems capable of purging unnatural poisons.
